species.name: Yellow perch
why: Water 43°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 6–30 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.

species.name: Walleye
why: Water 43°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 8–32 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
East wind at 30 mph pushes bait onto the west shore: try the wind-blown banks.
Clear water: they bite best at dawn, dusk and on cloudy days.
